description: [No sign-in required] List every public delivery template with {} or filter by scenario and customer industry, for example {"query":"n8n","industry":"retail"}. Both filters apply. All matches arrive in one items array in catalog order, without relevance ranking. If empty, drop a filter. To check one saved slug and version, call getTemplate directly.

industry.description: Copy an industry label from items[].industry in an unfiltered listing, for example "Retail". Matching is exact and ignores case. Omit to search across industries.

query.description: Words describing the delivery, for example "n8n" or "chatbot". Omit to browse without a keyword filter.

name: findTemplates

items.description: All matches, possibly empty. The count is items.length.
One published delivery specification at an exact version.

acceptanceRule.description: How the published specification describes acceptance.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest identifying the selected template revision.

scenario.description: Delivery scenario covered by this template.

slug.description: Pass this slug and its sibling version to getTemplate.

template.description: Versioned template content for the parties to review.

criteria.description: Completion criteria with their evidence requirements.

title: Browse public delivery templates
